name: Sled
summary: Wooden toboggan sledge with a plank seat, a curled front and two runners, in side view; for snow and winter scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the runners stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 680 px wide and 220 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = the sled bounces over the snow (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the curled front faces left

author: krakujs
